note: Per-TRAINING-SECTION MISSION and OBJECTIVE, verbatim from the Phase 2 Syllabus PART IV section blocks (printed typos kept). Read by app/description.js: the MISSION/OBJECTIVE line under the sortie bar and the seeds of the R17 enriched mission sentences derive from these texts. Course material only - no person data.
referee_note: Reconciled 2026-08-20 from two blind extractions (ALPHA, BRAVO) against the PDF. BRAVO's output truncated after C51XX, so the 23 post-C51XX sections were single-source; the referee page-verified all 23 (zero ALPHA errors found). The 30 fully overlapping sections had zero substantive disagreements; 7/30 (23%) re-verified on the printed page (pdf pp. 141, 148, 156, 161, 167, 175, 178) plus all category mission tables and general-program tables (pdf pp. 139, 163, 166, 191, 207, 223) as cross-checks. Printed page number = pdf page - 8. Category totals reconcile with the section pages everywhere except the known I41XX conflict (see its note).
hours_note: hours normalized to dot-decimals (PDF mixes comma and dot); MISSION/OBJECTIVE verbatim from PDF incl. printed typos (label variants MISSIONS/OBJECTIVES exist on some pages); the text layer prints Greek homoglyphs inside some codes (e.g. B10XX, N23XX, N4690 with Greek Nu/Chi) - codes here are normalized ASCII; sortie_ids expanded from the XX pattern as 01..NN (convention confirmed by printed ids B1001, B1002, C1101, C2101, C4101, C4602, C5201, I3201, I3601, I4501, I4603, F4301, F4501, C4790, C4791); F/S 'device' field from the BRAVO extraction, page-verified on B10XX, C2501, I36XX, N23XX; instrument and navigation A/C section pages print no SOLO line at all (solo_sorties_hours null there), contact and formation pages print an explicit 0/0 or 0/0.0
